name: TxDOT Austin
text: TRAFFIC ALERT: Southbound I-35 mainlanes between Holly Street and Woodland Avenue will be closed Wednesday, Oct. 21, from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m., for striping. Use Riverside Drive exit (233) and continue on the Riverside Drive bypass to reenter mainlanes. #My35 #ATXtraffic pic.twitter.com/x2WydyfKqu
